english.title: Keeper of equine fail to provide necessary information to issuing body to complete an existing ID
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), failed to provide to the issuing body all information necessary to allow the body to complete an existing ID for the purposes of Article 15(2) of EU Regulation 2015/262, subject to Article 15(3) of that Regulation, so that it complied with the requirements of Article 7(2) in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7, 22(2) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
